cross_backend_notes: Live two-client behavior split the lanes: Convex useQuery greened M1–M8 choreography, Snapback live views greened only through M2 before AuthGate/ChatRail loading, and Supabase substituted 200–700ms polls for unused Realtime and missed the 2s typing window.

Snapback’s 642-line Quarry file was the server (identity, view following, reports delivery, expire, image once, job digest); Convex and Supabase reimplemented receipts, unread, and expiry as TypeScript or store.mjs.
Auth was a product on Snapback (use identity password) and Supabase (email/password), and a bcrypt sessions table with a token argument on every Convex function.
Offline was Snapback’s engine (held search, pending, custody) versus the same localStorage outbox on Convex and Supabase — only Convex’s web M6/M8 offline segments greened.

None finished the 167k scale envelope: Snapback matched the 10% prefix then --fresh upload died, Convex collect() hit the 32k-document read limit, and Supabase stopped before 10% on the hosted pooler.
